player_results AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN team_side = 'home' AND home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN team_side = 'home' AND home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'loss'
            WHEN team_side = 'away' AND away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN team_side = 'away' AND away_team_goal < home_team_goal THEN 'loss'
        END AS result
    FROM player_matches
    WHERE (team_side = 'home' AND home_team_goal != away_team_goal)
       OR (team_side = 'away' AND away_team_goal != home_team_goal)
),
player_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
    FROM player_results
    GROUP BY player_id
),
max_wins AS (
    SELECT player_id, win_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY win_count DESC) as rn
    FROM player_counts
),
max_losses AS (
    SELECT player_id, loss_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY loss_count DESC) as rn
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT 'highest_wins' as category, p.player_name, CAST(mw.win_count AS INTEGER) as match_count
FROM max_wins mw
JOIN Player p ON mw.player_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE mw.rn = 1
UNION ALL

FROM max_losses ml
JOIN Player p ON ml.player_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ml.rn = 1
